name: initial_report_residential_fire
description: SME-provided initial radio report (2026-05): two-story single-family residence, smoke and fire showing, family evacuated. Initial size-up transmission plus a 360 follow-up. Tests extraction on a short, naturalistic size-up rather than a full incident transcript. SOURCE: SME 'Initial Radio Reports' Scenario 1 — transcript preserved verbatim as the audit-of-record.

expected_outcomes._note: PROVISIONAL — derived from the transcript, NOT yet confirmed by the SME. Replace with the SME's answer key once received (see SME-Request follow-up). These are the items a competent reviewer would likely surface.
conforming_examples: Command formally established and named (Hughes assuming command)
360 walkaround conducted and reported complete before sustained interior operations
Offensive strategy declared for a working fire with occupants confirmed evacuated
Mutual aid requested and ladder company deployed
deviating_safe_examples: Offensive mode and entry preparation announced in the initial transmission before the 360 was reported complete (sequencing) — flag only if extraction infers entry began pre-360

transcript:
Engine one is on scene at 10002 106 street, we have a two-story single-family residence with smoke and fire showing, family appears to be evacuated on the front lawn. Crews are establishing a water supply and preparing for entry through the front door, we are in offensive mode. Continue to deploy ladder 1 and call mutual aid. Hughes is assuming command. Stand by for follow up report
360 is complete, fire appears to be in Charlie-delta corner of basement, will remain in offensive strategy. Family has confirmed they are all accounted for. Accountability is alpha side.
